keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Full-text search across opportunity titles and descriptions, e.g. "artificial intelligence", "rural broadband", "workforce development". Leave empty to return every opportunity matching your other filters.

oppStatuses.title: Opportunity status
oppStatuses.description: Which opportunities to include. 'posted' = open for applications now. 'forecasted' = announced but not yet open. 'closed' and 'archived' are historical and are useful for trend analysis.

includeDetails.title: Include full opportunity details
includeDetails.description: Fetch the complete synopsis for every result: award ceiling and floor, total program funding, expected number of awards, eligible applicant types, cost-sharing requirement, agency contact email, and the full plain-text description. Turn this OFF for a faster, cheaper list of titles and deadlines only.

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Stop after this many opportunities. Use a small number while you tune your filters, then raise it. Maximum 50000.

agencies.title: Agency codes
agencies.description: Restrict to specific agencies by their Grants.gov code, e.g. "NSF", "HHS-NIH11", "USDA-NIFA", "DOE-GFO". Leave empty for all agencies.
agencies.sectionDescription: All of these are optional. Filters combine with AND.

aln.title: Assistance Listing Number (ALN / CFDA)
aln.description: Filter by a single Assistance Listing Number, e.g. "47.075". Formerly known as the CFDA number.

opportunityNumber.title: Opportunity number
opportunityNumber.description: Look up one specific opportunity by its number, e.g. "PD-19-127Y".

eligibilities.title: Eligible applicant codes
eligibilities.description: Grants.gov eligibility codes. Common ones: 06 = public/state higher education, 12 = small businesses, 20 = private institutions of higher education, 21 = nonprofits without 501(c)(3), 25 = others, 99 = unrestricted.

fundingCategories.title: Funding category codes
fundingCategories.description: Grants.gov category codes. Common ones: ST = science & technology, HL = health, ED = education, EN = energy, ENV = environment, AG = agriculture, BC = business & commerce.
